answer.answer: PM JANMAN stands for PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan [E01]. It targets Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) [E01], aiming to improve their socio-economic status by bridging gaps in health, education, and livelihoods, and by saturating PVTG communities and families with basic facilities and services [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: PM JANMAN stands for PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan
